title: Query-efficient winner prediction in district-based elections
abstract: arXiv:2610.00577v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In a district-based election, N voters are partitioned into k districts, and each voter votes for one of m candidates. Each district elects a winner using the plurality rule (i.e. the candidate getting the largest number of votes is declared the winner, breaking ties as per some fixed rule), and the overall winner is determined by applying plurality to the district winners; we assume that there is a unique winner amongst the district winners. The margin of victory of such an election is the minimum number of votes that must be altered so that the current winner ceases to be the unique district winner. We study the problem of predicting the winner of a district-based election in the query complexity model, where one has query access to individual votes. translated_title: 基于选区选举中查询高效的获胜者预测
translated_abstract: 在基于选区的选举中，N名选民被划分为k个选区，每位选民为m名候选人中的一名投票。每个选区采用多数制（plurality rule）选出获胜者（即得票最多的候选人当选，平票时按某个固定规则打破），而总体获胜者则通过对各选区获胜者再次应用多数制来确定；我们假设各选区获胜者中存在唯一的总体获胜者。这种选举的“胜利边际”是指为使当前获胜者不再成为唯一的总体获胜者所必须改变的最少票数。我们在查询复杂度模型中研究基于选区选举的获胜者预测问题，其中可以对单个选票进行查询访问，目标是最小化查询次数。这一设置对应于出口民调场景，其中查询相当于采访选民，并且与查询复杂度领域中的问题密切相关。
tldr: 该论文研究了在查询复杂度模型下基于选区选举的获胜者预测问题，目标是最小化对选民投票的查询次数，对应于出口民调等实际应用场景。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the problem of predicting the winner of a district-based election in the query complexity model, aiming to minimize the number of queries to individual votes, a setting that captures exit polling.
